_source: Built from the per-field examples, error bodies and headers in Tavily's API reference (https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search) and rate-limit page (https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/rate-limits). The reference publishes one example per field rather than one whole reply, so the success body assembles those examples; the empty and malformed bodies drop fields from it. Error bodies are the reference's own examples.
